name: Home value estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: A home value estimate is a starting point, but it may not capture condition, upgrades, location on the street, views, lot attributes, building-specific factors, or recent market changes. Kelby Contreras provides a more tailored property valuation for Miami and South Florida sellers.
